terms.comment: Said by the one who waits; to a woman salvam, to several salvōs vōs.

phrases.latin: Mea māter, salvē. — Gaudeō vēnisse salvum.
phrases.english: Mother, hello. — I’m glad you’ve come back safe (the son arriving, the mother waiting)

phrases.latin: Ō pater, pater mī, salvē. — Salvē multum, gnāte mī.
phrases.english: Father, my father, hello! — A hearty hello, my son.
You’ve come! O happy news for me!

sources: Passages as cited on the grouped card.
